scope: WP4a Tier-1 bridge, runbook v4 §3.5.7; objective definitions from v3 WP4 (v4 §2 keeps v3 in force)
status: frozen numeric config for independent pre-outcome review; no sample grid or reported run is authorized until reviewed (v3 G6 WP4 item)

data.law: A4 at g = 0.02, nominal SNR, channel split
data.gap: none (channel split; every raw sample belongs to context or target)

fixed_scaling.contract: one scalar mean and one scalar std per channel, fitted once on disjoint calibration-noise records, stored as buffers and held fixed; no per-event normalisation anywhere
fixed_scaling.status: frozen from the registered A4 generator (v4-A4-waveform-v1, base_rho 0, g 0.02, channel split); never refitted by the bridge, robustness shifts reuse these values

target_noise_covariance.definition: target marginal of N_actual = A4 base noise + epsilon_dc*I + line + common (v3 §4.1), at masks.raw_split('channel').target (all 256 samples of channels 4-7)
target_noise_covariance.status: frozen; matrix not stored (lean-repository rule): recomputed deterministically by jepa_noise.train.a4_bridge_products()

backbone.implementation: subclass of reconstruction_model.model.Transformer; package is no-touch
backbone.factorised: serial time branch then channel branch (registered default); parallel time || channel ablation selected only by arm sigreg_jepa_parallel
backbone.readout: (B, n_patch, C, d_model) token grid after the spatial/channel layers and BEFORE final_proj_norm; used by every loss and probe
backbone.mask_embedding: one learned vector per channel, shared over patches, replaces non-context tokens after patch embedding and before attention
backbone.post_time_representation: (B, C, n_patch, d_model) after the time block, before the channel layers; used by the amplitude-preservation probe

predictor.queries: one learned target positional query per target token (n_target, d_pred)
predictor.reads: context outputs plus queries only; no target or gap raw data

source.paper: Balestriero & LeCun, "LeJEPA: Provable and Scalable Self-Supervised Learning Without the Heuristics", arXiv:2511.08544 (2025)
source.pinned_classes_and_defaults: EppsPulley(t_max=3.0, n_points=17); SlicedEppsPulley(num_slices=1024, t_max=3.0, n_points=17); LeJEPA(lamb=0.02, n_slices=1024, t_max=3.0, n_points=17); slice directions from a step-seeded torch.Generator
source.verification: the file fetched at this commit matches the implementation in src/jepa_noise/sigreg.py (defaults, quadrature, N factor, mean-over-slices reduction)

sigreg.test: sliced Epps-Pulley goodness-of-fit against an isotropic standard Gaussian
sigreg.quadrature: t = linspace(0, t_max, n_points); trapezoid weights 2*dt interior and dt at both ends, multiplied by exp(-t^2/2)
sigreg.slice_directions: N(0,1) columns normalised to unit L2 norm, drawn from a step-seeded torch.Generator (source behaviour)
sigreg.reduction: per-slice statistic (err @ weights) * N; mean over slices; then mean over samples
sigreg.coefficient_source: LeJEPA class default lamb=0.02 in the pinned source; never chosen by claim performance
applied_to: target token embeddings flattened over batch
sigreg.combination: 0.5 * (value_context + value_target); total objective adds lambda * SIGReg
sigreg.note: the pinned statistic carries the source's per-call sample-count factor N; the target term therefore enters the average with n_target times more samples than the pooled context term. This is a pinned-source consequence, not a tuned choice.
sigreg.n_factor_note: Pinned source reduction: EppsPulley returns (err @ weights) * N, where N is the number of samples passed to that call, and SlicedEppsPulley reduces by the mean over slices; no normalisation is added. Consequently the SIGReg value on the B pooled context embeddings carries N=B, while the value on B*n_target flattened target tokens carries N=B*n_target. With the v3 WP4 average 0.5*(context+target) the target term therefore enters n_target=32 times more strongly per sample. This is kept exactly as the pinned implementation reduces it (no invented normalisation) and is flagged for the pre-outcome review as a frozen property of the config.

objective.sigreg_jepa: prediction L2 (predictor output vs target-view token embeddings, shared weights, no stop-gradient) + lambda * SIGReg
objective.sigreg_jepa_anchored: sigreg_jepa + beta * mean_b ||z_tilde - z||^2 / max(trace(Cov(z)), 1e-6); z, z_tilde are unmasked pooled embeddings of the event and of the event plus an independent calibration-noise overlay; gradients flow through numerator and trace denominator
objective.mae_chi2: context-masked reconstruction through a linear target-token head with the exact target marginal N_actual weighting, 0.5 * r^T N_tt^{-1} r; the parameter-free log-determinant is omitted; LABELLED AS USING ORACLE NOISE INFORMATION

anchor.beta_rule: v3 §1.3 on an independent Tier-1 development cohort (g = 0.02, nominal, development seed 100); ties within 1e-8 relative favour the smaller coefficient; beta is NOT selected by this implementation and is not chosen from reported outcomes

optimizer.convention: repository conventions in reconstruction_model.model.Transformer.configure_optimisers (AdamW + Muon), frozen before outcomes

groups.muon: every 2-D matrix inside the temporal, spatial, predictor and merge block modules
groups.adamw: patch_embedding, absolute positional embedding, mask embedding, block norms/biases, predictor in/out projections and target queries, reconstruction head
groups.frozen: final_proj_norm, spatial_head, energy_head (unused by the pre-norm read-out)
groups.coverage_check: every trainable non-EMA parameter occurs exactly once; enforced at optimizer construction and tested

optimizer.implicit_compile: disabled for CPU checks via RECONSTRUCTION_DISABLE_TORCH_COMPILE=1 (v3 §3.1)

training.schedule: not implemented in WP4a; WP5 owns the schedule. The local CPU smoke uses a constant step with no schedule.
training.device: CPU for WP4a tests/smoke; bridge training for the registered run is on Deepthought Titans (v4 §6.1), fp32 with TF32 disabled

amplitude_preservation.probe: linear ridge on per-channel read-out token features and on the post-time-block per-channel representation
amplitude_preservation.measured: after training (after the smoke and on the final encoders); the random-init fixture value reported by the unit test is not the registered criterion

pre_outcome_review: pending independent review of this frozen config (v3 G6 WP4 item: optimizer/SIGReg sourcing and numeric settings)
decisions: Fixed scaling is one scalar mean and one scalar std per channel (not per sample position), fitted once on 4096 disjoint calibration-noise records (role noise_cal, ids 0-4095, seed 0, cell 'bridge'); no per-event normalisation anywhere.

The learned mask embedding is one vector per channel, shared over the eight patches; masked-token position identity comes from the predictor's per-target positional queries, not from patch-wise mask vectors.

Token masks are (channel-set x patch-set) products in channel-major token order; the target token order matches masks.raw_split('channel').target so mae_chi2 patch predictions align with the raw target labels.

Predictor: d_pred=64, 2 full-attention blocks, 4 heads (d_head 16), d_ff=256=4*d_pred, d_pred->d_model output projection; v3 WP4 pins d_pred, the block count and target positional queries only, so heads/d_ff/output projection are engineering choices frozen here.

Parallel factorised-attention ablation: one parallel level for depths (1,1); time-branch and channel-branch outputs are concatenated to 2*d_model and projected by one linear merge per level; merge weights join the Muon group.
beta grid {0.1, 1, 10} from v3 §1.3; beta=1.0 is used only as a labelled smoke/unit-test placeholder - not a selection; selection happens on the independent Tier-1 development cohort.

Read-out is the spatial/channel-layer output before final_proj_norm; final_proj_norm, spatial_head and energy_head are unused by the bridge and frozen (requires_grad=False) so optimizer coverage means 'used'.

Anchor denominator uses the unbiased (B-1) divisor in trace(Cov(z)) with gradients through the trace; mae_chi2 omits the parameter-free log-determinant; AdamW fused=False and implicit torch.compile disabled for CPU checks (v3 §3.1).

Calibration/overlay noise namespaces: noise_cal ids 0-4095 for fixed scaling and noise_overlay ids 0-63 for the anchor bank, both from the registered A4 g=0.02 bridge cell (seed 0, cell 'bridge'); the namespaces are disjoint.

N_actual target marginal is frozen as sha256 + deterministic recipe rather than a stored matrix (lean-repository rule); jepa_noise.train.a4_bridge_products() recomputes it, and mae_chi2 remains labelled as using oracle noise information.
